answer: Draw juries of 5 from distinct subnetworks at the dawn of each epoch, and let a juror serve only if it produced fresh work within the last 2 epochs. A panel whose members trace to one operator is voided and re-drawn from the rotating pool. A 40-account cluster graded its own submissions last week; the diversity check voided 6 of its 7 panels and the accounts lost the epoch. The pigment of a fake jury shows in the subnet map before the first vote, and an anchor of real work is the only way to hold a seat.
